mission: collector-sibling-on/off ops-write runbooks (owner decision 2026-10-25, perfectionist): set RAW_DICTIONARY_SIBLING on all ten collectors and make it live by re-uploading each fleet-pinned commit (Railway no longer redeploys collector images). Per collector in its safe slot: refuse if deployed since the dry run; stage with --skip-deploys and prove no deployment started; re-upload with a one-off nonce in the build-only marker (REVISION unchanged; release and rollback uploads byte-identical as before); refuse a skipped upload; verify active, SUCCESS, exact marker, schedule, start command and flags. Stop on failure, revert only a collector whose value was staged; per-collector 80-minute budget against the job (360 min) and the next 02:00/19:30 UTC quiet window. Independent review: FAIL then PASS WITH NITS (nits applied).
